name: @schoolerp/contracts
description: Single source of truth for SchoolERP's API shapes: one Zod schema per operation, defining request AND response. Backend validates against these and has its response type-checked against them; frontend uses them as react-hook-form resolvers and as the response type. Consumed as a built package (dist/) by both backend and frontend so each side's own bundler/compiler (tsc/commonjs for backend, Vite/esbuild for frontend) resolves it the normal npm way — no path-alias-to-source tricks.
